purpose: Pinned result of the operator's local state-dict shape probe of the canonical diag_kg checkpoint. Read by ehr_evidence_app.gnn.assets, which never deserialises the checkpoint; it only checks that this record names the pinned checkpoint identity and that the label vocabulary length equals the recorded head widths.
limitations: Only the output widths of graph_head and seq_head are recorded. Equal widths show dimensional compatibility with the 275-entry label vocabulary; they do not establish that checkpoint output index i corresponds to label vocabulary entry i.
The shape probe ran locally under operator control. The validator does not repeat it and does not load, unpickle or execute the checkpoint.
